description: Check whether a keyboard and mousepad fit side by side on a desk. The keyboard is placed with its B key in front of the screen centre (move it with keyboard_offset_cm). Returns the mouse room left, whether the pad fits or how far it hangs off, how far the mouse sits from the screen centre, and whether a full 360-degree turn at the given sensitivity (cm/360) fits on the pad.

cm_per_360.description: Mouse sensitivity as cm of movement for a full 360 turn

desk_width_cm.description: Usable width of the desk surface in centimetres (inches x 2.54).

keyboard_offset_cm.description: How far to shift the keyboard sideways from the centred position, in cm. Negative shifts it left, positive right.

keyboards.description: The keyboards to place on the desk, as size names (TKL, 75%) or keyboard models. Each one is checked on its own.

left_handed.description: Mouse on the left of the keyboard

mousepad.description: Mousepad preset. In cm: small 25x21, medium 36x30, large 45x40, xl 49x42; a deskmat (90x40) sits under both keyboard and mouse. Use custom together with mousepad_width_cm.

mousepad_width_cm.description: Width of a custom mousepad in centimetres.

name: check_desk_fit

kind.description: "size" for a standard layout, "model" for a keyboard measured in an HLPlanet review

measured.description: True when the dimensions come from an HLPlanet review

review_url.description: HLPlanet review, for measured keyboards only

mouse_room_cm.description: Desk width left for the mouse beside the keyboard

pad_spare_cm.description: Room left beside the pad; negative means it hangs off the desk

planner_url.description: The desk drawn to scale on HLPlanet

turn_360.description: Null when cm_per_360 was not given

title: Check desk and mousepad fit
